references.text: The Lord confused the Egyptians and destroyed their chariots, just as he confused Sisera and his army at the Kishon River.
The Lord sends confusion before his people to drive out the enemies, just as he did with Sisera.
The Lord confused the enemies and struck them with large stones, just as he confused Sisera's army.
The Lord confused the Philistines with thunder, just as he confused Sisera and his chariots.
The psalm mentions Sisera and his defeat at the Kishon River as an example of God's victory over the enemies.
Parallel account of Sisera's defeat where the Lord confused him and his entire army.
Deborah's song describes how the stars fought against Sisera and the Kishon River swept away the enemies.
